partners.mechanism_chain: RAD21 (HGNC:9827) —DISRUPTS→ Cohesin complex function (GO:0000790); Cohesin complex function (GO:0000790) —LEADS_TO→ Syndromic microphthalmia with or without ectropion (HP:0030171); NUP107 (HGNC:8149) —DISRUPTS→ Nuclear pore complex assembly and function (GO:0005624); Nuclear pore complex assembly and function (GO:0005624) —LEADS_TO→ Nephrotic syndrome (HP:0011294); Cohesin complex function (GO:0000790) —BINDS→ Nuclear pore complex assembly and function (GO:0005624).
